resources.string:
Connect your headset in Android Bluetooth settings. Tap its route button below, then open ChatGPT and test with the phone several metres away.

While enabled, this version loops silent communication playback to keep the route request active. It never records audio. This uses phone and headset battery and can reduce media quality.

If ChatGPT changes the route, try Reapply headset in the notification during your voice session. Android and ChatGPT can still override this request. Stop routing after testing.
Grant Nearby devices permission to select a headset.
No SCO/HFP or BLE headset communication device is available. Connect a headset that supports calls, then refresh.
